package greet

import "strings"

// Farewell trims the name and returns Goodbye, <name>!. An empty name is an error.
func Farewell(name string) (string, error) {
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" {
		return "", &NameError{Reason: "name is empty"}
	}
	return "Goodbye, " + name + "!", nil
}
